method.draft: bicycle prior (speed, accel, yaw-rate) + residual MLP on prefill hidden and 16-d ego extras; supervised on teacher waypoints
method.verify: longest prefix inside lon/lat metre box; first fail replaced by teacher waypoint then teacher suffix
method.speedup_definition: decode-step accounting: spec_steps = 1 parallel verify + remaining serial teacher steps. NOT wall-clock speculative decoding (no parallel token verify implemented).

autovla.eval: nuScenes val, stride 2, 2000 frames, held-out from train cache

opendrive.teacher: OpenDriveVLA-0.5B + UniAD scene/track/map, official AR generate
opendrive.eval: hash 15% holdout of nuScenes val hiddens (903); draft trained on the other 5116 of the same official val split (no separate OD train-set cache)
